work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult LXX grants violet collar, cassock and hat tassel to the Faenza cathedral canons and rochet and mantelletta to the provost; LF12776 → LF12782 across page-87 running title LF12779; short final lines LF12825/12839 are in order; LF12843 provin- → LF12852 cialibusque across own provenance LF12846 and page number 88 LF12849; complete 22 September 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF12749–12749; the source closing at LF12859–12862 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo. piscatoris die vigesima secunda septembris miflesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anna quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
